title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Recruitment Administrator

Location: Leeds
Salary: 27,500 - 28,000 per annum
Job Type: Full-time, Office Based

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly organised Recruitment Administrator to join our busy Leeds team.

This is a varied, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll be supporting the recruitment team with candidate onboarding, pre-employment checks and general administration, ensuring everything is completed accurately and on time.

We're looking for someone who is naturally organised, enjoys working with people and can confidently manage multiple tasks and priorities.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing the candidate onboarding process from registration through to placement
- Completing pre-employment and compliance checks
- Checking and maintaining candidate documentation
- Carrying out right-to-work and identification checks
- Updating internal systems and databases
- Managing candidate records and ensuring information is accurate and up to date
- Supporting recruiters with day-to-day administration
- Communicating with candidates and clients professionally
- Responding to emails and queries promptly
- Managing multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
- General office administration and recruitment support

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Enthusiastic, positive and motivated
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- A confident communicator with a good telephone manner
- Friendly, approachable and professional
- Able to multi-task and prioritise in a busy environment
- Comfortable working to deadlines and targets
- IT literate and confident using Microsoft Office and computer systems
- Reliable, proactive and able to use their own initiative
- A strong team player who enjoys working in a busy office environment

Previous recruitment or administration experience would be beneficial, but attitude, organisation and a willingness to learn are equally important.

What We Offer
- 27,500 - 28,000 salary
- Leeds-based office role
- Temp to Perm
- Monday-Friday, office based
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Varied and interesting role
- Opportunity to develop your career within recruitment

Interested?

If you are an organised, enthusiastic administrator who enjoys working with people and wants to build a career within recruitment, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV!

title: HR Administrator
description:
Getting the detail right across people records makes a real difference to every employee in a business. As an HR Administrator, you'll help keep those essential processes running smoothly while becoming a trusted first point of contact for day-to-day employee queries.

You'll join a growing organisation and work closely with the HR Manager as part of a small supportive people team. Alongside managing core HR administration, you'll have the opportunity to spot better ways of working and contribute to improvements across the department.

HR Administrator, What's in it for you
- £27,000 - £29,000 salary, pro rata for 25 hours per week.
- Permanent, part-time position offering consistent weekday hours.
- Hybrid working, giving you a balance between home and office.
- The opportunity to work across a broad range of generalist people activities.
- Exposure to payroll data, recruitment, employee records and HR systems.
- Scope to contribute ideas and improve existing processes as the organisation grows.

Your responsibilities as HR Administrator
- Act as a first point of contact for employee queries, providing accurate guidance and escalating matters where appropriate.
- Manage administration across starters, contractual changes, leavers, time and attendance, ensuring records remain accurate and up to date.
- Collate and check employee data for pay processing, investigating discrepancies and providing supporting evidence where required.
- Maintain employee information within the HRIS and produce accurate reports for the wider People team.
- Support absence monitoring, recruitment and induction, including creating adverts, reviewing applications and arranging interviews.
- Prepare employee correspondence, templates and forms while reviewing administrative processes to identify opportunities for improvement.

What we're looking for in a HR Administrator
- Proven experience delivering day-to-day HR administration ideally gained within a small to medium business.
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or currently working towards it would be advantageous.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Excel and experience analysing data; VLOOKUP and PivotTable knowledge would be an advantage.
- Experience maintaining accurate employee records and working with HR information systems.
- Adaptability and ability to use own initiative and good problem-solving skills
- Ideally payroll administering payroll data , checking information and producing reports
- Excellent attention to detail
- Working hours: 25 hours per week across five days.

If you're ready to bring your experience to a busy people team and make an impact across employee administration, apply today for the HR Administrator position.

Candidate Source Ltd is an advertising agency. Once you have submitted your application it will be passed to the third party Recruiter who is responsible for processing your application. This will include holding and sharing your personal data, our legal basis for this is legitimate interest subject to your declared interest in a job. Our privacy policy can be found on our website and we can be contacted to confirm who your application has been forwarded to.
